Your skin barrier is a brick wall 🧱
Skin cells are the bricks, lipids are the mortar. Over-exfoliate and the mortar cracks: water escapes, irritants get in. Ceramides and a break from acids fix it.

Why Seoul has almost no trash cans 🗑️

What niacinamide actually does inside your skin 🔬
Melanocytes make pigment and hand it up to the cells above. Niacinamide slows that handoff, so dark spots fade over time. Bonus: more ceramides, stronger barrier.
2–5% is enough. Give it 8 weeks.
Ingredient Explained, ep. 01. Next: centella.

What centella actually does to irritated skin 🌿
Irritation builds inflammation under the surface. Centella (cica) helps calm it and supports your barrier while it repairs.
On the label: centella asiatica, madecassoside, asiaticoside.
